mapper.select: SELECT user_id, chat_id, enabled FROM telegram_connections WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telegram_connections(user_id, link_hash, link_expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{hash}, now() + interval '10 minutes') ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET link_hash = EXCLUDED.link_hash, link_expires_at = EXCLUDED.link_expires_at
mapper.select: UPDATE telegram_connections SET chat_id = #{chatId}, enabled = true, link_hash = NULL, link_expires_at = NULL WHERE link_hash = #{hash} AND link_expires_at > now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telegram_connections c WHERE c.chat_id = #{chatId} AND c.link_hash IS DISTINCT FROM #{hash}) RETURNING user_id, chat_id, enabled
mapper.update: UPDATE telegram_connections SET chat_id = NULL, enabled = false, link_hash = NULL, link_expires_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM telegram_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('pending', 'sending')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telegram_notifications(user_id, chat_id, event_key, message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{chatId}, #{eventKey}, #{message}) ON CONFLICT(event_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT n.id FROM telegram_notifications n JOIN telegram_connections c ON c.user_id = n.user_id AND c.chat_id = n.chat_id AND c.enabled = true JOIN users u ON u.id = n.user_id AND u.enabled = true WHERE (n.status = 'pending' AND n.next_attempt_at <= now()) OR (n.status = 'sending' AND n.claimed_at < now() - interval '2 minutes') ORDER BY n.created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF n SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE telegram_notifications n SET status = 'sending', claimed_at = now(), attempts = attempts + 1 FROM candidate WHERE n.id = candidate.id RETURNING n.id, n.user_id, n.chat_id, n.message, n.attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE telegram_notifications SET status = 'sent' WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE telegram_notifications SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= 10 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END, next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(3600, 30 * attempts * attempts)) WHERE id = #{id}
